name: 1X NEO
summary: A light (about 30 kg) home humanoid with two five-finger hands, sold for private households in the US; it is not offered in Germany.

germany.statusNote: Orders and deliveries are for US homes only. 1X says US deliveries begin in 2026 and international deliveries will follow later, with no date or country list. heise (Oct 2025) reports that further markets are to follow from 2027.

priceOther.market: US early-access purchase with 3-year warranty (alternative: USD 499 per month subscription)

specs.label: Arm payload
specs.conditions: stated as 18 lb; per arm or total not stated

specs.label: Walking speed
specs.conditions: walking; 6.2 m/s stated as max run speed

specs.label: Quick charge
specs.value: 6 minutes of charging per hour of runtime

specs.label: Compute
specs.value: 1X NEO Cortex (NVIDIA Jetson Thor), up to 2070 FP4 TFLOPS

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: dual 8.85 MP 90 Hz stereo fisheye cameras, 4 beamforming microphones

specs.label: DoF by body part
specs.value: hands 2 x 22, arms 2 x 7, neck 3, spine 2, legs 2 x 6

notes: Built for homes: 1X says NEO is to be operated in and around the home on firm ground; the hands are waterproof (IP68), the body only splash-proof (IP44).
Chores it does not know are done with a remote 1X Expert operator (1X staff in the USA) guiding the robot.
No industrial or construction use is offered.

images.alt: Three 1X NEO home humanoids in grey, beige and dark brown knit suits, side view

evidence.task: Household chores such as tidying, laundry and fetching items in private homes
evidence.note: Consumer use case; no construction or industrial task.
